summary: Describes a way for an SSH client and server to agree on a shared secret using RSA public-key encryption instead of Diffie-Hellman. It needs much less computing time on the client, which helps slow devices. It is a proposed standard from 2006.

eli5.summary: Two people need a secret code word. Instead of a slow back-and-forth puzzle, one locks the word in a box only the other can open. That is faster for a slow little computer.

questions: faster ssh key exchange for slow clients
